# ReasonShield | Reason Shield

> ReasonShield (also known as Reason Shield) is a modern web application developed by ReasonWorks AI Inc. It focuses on processing laboratory results with specialized tools for microbiology data analysis, antimicrobial resistance assessment, and clinical decision support. Our laboratory data platform transforms complex lab data into actionable clinical insights.

For comprehensive information about ReasonShield (Reason Shield), a product of ReasonWorks AI Inc., see our [full documentation](https://reasonshield.com/llms-full.txt).

## Alternative Names and References
- ReasonShield
- Reason Shield
- Reason-Shield
- The ReasonShield Platform

- A ReasonWorks AI Inc. product
